# WebView

**Class:** `UltraCanvasWebView` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasWebView.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasWebView.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasWebView.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A web page from a URL (http(s) or a file): fetched, laid out as native elements by the HTML reader, scrolled, with links, `#fragments`, back / forward, forms the reader fills in and sends, and an error page; no JavaScript. The host gives it the network (`HTML::PageLoaderServices`). For HTML you already have in memory, build it with `HTML::ElementBuilder`

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
explicit UltraCanvasWebView(const std::string& identifier, float w = 0, float h = 0);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetScheduler()` | `void SetScheduler(std::function<void(std::function<void()>)> post)` | Runs a task on a later turn of the UI loop. Rebuilds go through it, never from inside a layout pass. |
| `onUrlChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::string& url)> onUrlChanged` | _Url changed_ |
| `onTitleChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::string& title)> onTitleChanged` | _Title changed_ |
| `onLoadingChanged` | `std::function<void(bool loading)> onLoadingChanged` | _Loading changed_ |
| `onLinkHovered` | `std::function<void(const std::string& url)> onLinkHovered` | The link under the pointer, as an absolute URL ("" when it leaves). |
| `onExternalLink` | `std::function<void(const std::string& url)> onExternalLink` | A link the view does not follow itself: mailto:, tel:, another scheme. |
| `onOpenInNewWindow` | `std::function<void(const std::string& url)> onOpenInNewWindow` | A link that asks for another window - &lt;a target="_blank"&gt;, a named target, &lt;base target="_blank"&gt; - with the absolute address it leads to: a browser opens it in a new tab. Unset (or set after the page was built, until the next build), such links open in this view. Only addresses the view would open itself come here … |
| `onChooseFiles` | `std::function<void(bool multiple, const std::string& accept, std::function<void(std::vector<std::string> paths)> done)> onChooseFiles` | A file input's button: show a file dialog (several files when `multiple`; `accept` is the input's accept="" list as written) and call `done` with the chosen UTF-8 paths, none when cancelled. Unset, file inputs cannot choose (their button is disabled). |
| `onNonHtml` | `std::function<void(const HTML::LoadedPage& page)> onNonHtml` | A navigation that found no page (PageKind::Other - an app, a file to download: page.body, page.fileName, page.truncated): the host decides what to do with it. The page on show stays, with its address and history. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Options and setters

Everything that configures the element: appearance, behaviour and content.

| Member | Signature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `SetServices` | `void SetServices(HTML::PageLoaderServices services, HTML::PageLoaderLimits limits =` |  |
| `SetBuildOptions` | `void SetBuildOptions(const HTML::BuildOptions& options)` | Typography, colours and the reader's own CSS for every page. The resource loader and the link callbacks are the view's own and are replaced. |
| `SetInteractiveForms` | `void SetInteractiveForms(bool on)` | Forms the reader can fill in and send (on by default): real widgets (BuildOptions::interactiveForms), sent by GET as a navigation or by POST through PageLoaderServices::post. What was typed survives a rebuild of the page (a new width, pictures arriving). Off: forms are drawn for display only. |
| `SetMediaPlayback` | `void SetMediaPlayback(bool on)` | &lt;video&gt; and &lt;audio&gt; as players (on by default). Off: their fallback content is shown, as in a reader that plays nothing. |
| `SetOpensWebLinks` | `void SetOpensWebLinks(bool on)` | http(s) links followed in the view (on by default). Off - a viewer of local files with no network, such as the media viewer's HTML preview - they go to onExternalLink as mailto: does, and file: links still open here. |
| `Clear` | `void Clear()` | Nothing on show: the load in progress stopped, the page, its players and the history let go. |
